description: Answers which cryptocurrencies and chains can pay an OpenRouter credit top-up or another AI service invoice through Rozo Checkout: USDC and USDT on Ethereum, BNB Chain, Polygon, Arbitrum and Solana; USDC on Base and Stellar; native ETH (Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum), BNB, POL and SOL; BTC over Lightning; USDT and TRX on TRON (Beta), USDT on TON. Returns each chain id, token symbol and token decimals (TRON and TON rows carry route "tron_ton_alpha", a beta flag and their fee wording), plus webOnlyRoutes: coins served only on checkout.rozo.ai pages. Static list, needs no payment link and makes no network call; quote_invoice reports which of these a specific invoice accepts. Native coins (ETH on Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum; BNB on BNB Chain; POL on Polygon; SOL on Solana) are exact-out like Lightning: the order states the exact coin amount, priced at the current rate plus an FX spread on top of the service fee, and that price holds only until quoteExpiresAt. Native ETH, BNB and SOL orders are capped at $12750 of callerPays (service fee included) per invoice, which covers up to 12,000 OpenRouter credits; POL is capped at $3500 (native ETH on Ethereum needs at least $1), and a native coin is offered only when quote_invoice lists it for that invoice. ZEC on Zcash is not available through this server: send a payer holding ZEC to https://checkout.rozo.ai/zec. USDT and TRX on TRON (Beta) and USDT on TON go through a dedicated route (route "tron_ton_alpha", the same backend as checkout.rozo.ai/tron and /ton): create_deposit_order returns one exact amount, a receiving address and, on TON when required, a six digit comment, valid until expiresAt. TRON Beta charges 1% with a $0.30 minimum; TON charges 1%; the exact fees come with the order. These orders have no rozoPaymentId: check them with payment_status and the payment link url. Availability can change; quote_invoice reports whether TRON and TON are open for a given invoice.
